names.enchantment.soulsweapons.fast_hands.desc: Reduce charge time or increase use time for Guns.

names.enchantment.soulsweapons.ethereal.desc: Silver Bullets can go through walls.

names.enchantment.soulsweapons.chain_lightning: Silver Bullets damage nearby entities with soul infused lightning.
names.enchantment.soulsweapons.misfire_curse.d: Each Silver Bullet has a chance to explode and damage the user when shot.
Silver Bullets apply stacking Blight: more armor = more damage taken.
